mineAreaSafety.name: Käringryggen / Gladhammars gruvor
notes: Official stage text says the route goes up to the abandoned mine area and that mine holes can be viewed along the fence.
Official stage text states mine holes are up to about 110 m deep and about 75 m below Tjursbosjön water level.

Municipality and county sources describe the mine area as a remediated contamination site with heavy-metal leakage historically affecting Tjursbosjön; remediation work ran in 2011 with follow-up monitoring from 2013.
Treat fencing as a hard safety boundary and do not model mine/Tjursbosjön water as potable.
